acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, GitHub main is freshly observed; the exact target contains protected PR #2256, this authority publication merge, and all then-current legitimate main merges, with validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness successful for that exact target.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that active source is a1a459f6161f81f7ea05d4ee2c510eba1fc89033 or a verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main commit. Any identity mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are reconciled from intent, task/result, manifest, launcher, package, Registry snapshot and authority evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, Bureau runtime identity is integrity-valid, and the merged PR #2256 runtime_identity behavior is present in the installed release.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority. No successor is pre-created; any future runtime need must be justified against then-current live truth.

approval.note: Single-use runtime bootstrap for merged PR #2256 only. The current explicit @grabowski implementation request authorizes exactly one Bureau runtime convergence after protected publication/adoption/activation, fresh main/CI/source-identity checks, exact target binding, intent-bound Grabowski leases and immutable readback. No blind retry after any effect-started ambiguity.
